Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, O Refuge of those who seek refuge
And O Shelter of those who seek shelter
And O Savior of the perishing
And O Protector of the distressed
And O Merciful to the destitute
And O Answerer of the desperate
And O Treasure of the impoverished
And O Mender of the broken
And O Shelter of the disconnected
And O Helper of the oppressed
And O Protector of the fearful
And O Reliever of the distressed
And O Fortress of the refugees

Arabic text: إِنْ لَمْ أَعُذْ بِعِزَّتِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَعُوذُ
Translation: If I do not seek protection in Your Might, then with whom shall I seek protection?

Arabic text: وَإِنْ لَمْ أَلُذْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَلُوذُ
Translation: And if I do not seek refuge in Your Power, then with whom shall I seek refuge?

Arabic text: وَقَدْ أَلْجَأَتْنِيْ الذُّنُوبُ إِلَى التَّشَبُّثِ بِأَذْيَالِ عَفْوِكَ
Translation: My sins have compelled me to cling to the hem of Your forgiveness

Arabic text: وَأَحْوَجَتْنِيْ الْخَطَايَا إِلَى اسْتِفْتَاحِ أَبْوَابِ صَفْحِكَ
Translation: And my mistakes have forced me to seek the opening of the doors of Your pardon

Arabic text: وَدَعَتْنِيْ الْإِسَاءَةُ إِلَى الْإِنَاخَةِ بِفَنَاءِ عِزِّكَ
Translation: And my wrongdoings have called me to kneel at the courtyard of Your Might

Arabic text: وَحَمَلَتْنِيْ الْمَخَافَةُ مِنْ نَقِمَتِكَ عَلَى التَّمَسُّكِ بِعُرْوَةِ عَطْفِكَ
Translation: And my fear of Your punishment has led me to hold fast to the rope of Your Kindness

Arabic text: وَمَا أَحَقُّ مَنِ اعْتَصَمَ بِحَبْلِكَ أَنْ يُخْذَلَ
Translation: How fitting that one who holds onto Your rope should not be forsaken

Arabic text: وَلَا يَلِيقُ بِمَنِ اسْتَجَارَ بِعِزِّكَ أَنْ يُسْلَمَ أَوْ يُهْمَلَ
Translation: And it is not befitting that one who seeks protection in Your Might should be abandoned or neglected
My God, do not deprive us of Your protection
And do not strip us of Your care
And defend us from the pathways of destruction
For we are under Your watch, in Your shelter, and belong to You
I ask You by the right of Your special ones
From Your angels and the righteous among Your creation
To place upon us a shield
That saves us from destruction
And keeps us away from calamities
And shelters us from devastating afflictions
And to send down upon us from Your tranquility
And to cover our faces with the lights of Your love
And to give us refuge in Your strong pillar
And to encompass us in the protection of Your infallibility
By Your kindness and Your mercy
O Most Merciful of the merciful
